function: Frequency-domain channel prediction: angular power spectral density of clusters predicted in unknown frequency bands from measured bands (pp. 1, 4).
system: 1 omnidirectional Tx antenna, switched Rx planar arrays 4x4 (0.7 GHz) and 4x8 (2.3, 3.7 GHz), 100 MHz bandwidth, urban campus, no RIS (p. 8).
method: Convolutional autoencoder (unsupervised, MAE loss) combined with coupling Conv-GRU cells per cluster type; 500 epochs, trained on measured angular PSDs (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Own measurements at 0.7, 2.3, 3.7 GHz in Nanjing, 12,350 samples (8,620 LoS, 3,730 NLoS); Wireless InSite ray tracing 2.5-6 GHz for the bound (pp. 8-9, 13).
test_conditions: Predicts unseen bands: interpolation (train 0.7+3.7, test 2.3 GHz), extrapolation (train lower, test higher), RT bands up to 6 GHz; Case 2 uses different streets (pp. 9-13).
baselines: General LSTM network (autoencoder removed), GRU-based network, Conv-LSTM-based network, all learned; no non-learned predictor; RT only generates reference channels (pp. 10-13).
metrics: RMSE, MAPE (%) and NMSE between predicted and measured angular PSDs (pp. 10-11, Table III).
complexity: Total of 620,705 parameters in the proposed model (p. 9); no FLOPs or runtime reported.
openness: none; measured data and code not released, no link (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 8: "both the training data and testing data are collected from the channel measurements"; own campaign at 0.7, 2.3 and 3.7 GHz (Table I).
q2_support: p. 9: "interpolation prediction, which uses the lower and higher frequency band channels as training data and predicts the middle frequency band channels"; p. 12: "the training and validating data used in Case 2 simulations are collected from different streets".
q3_support: p. 10: "LSTM [47] and GRU [48], [49], are conducted as comparison methods" and "a general LSTM network, where the autoencoder is removed"; Table III (p. 11) lists only these learned networks. No non-learned predictor is compared; RT only gives reference channels (p. 13).
q4_support: p. 9: "the total number of parameters in the proposed model is 620,705".
q5_support: p. 8: "both the training data and testing data are collected from the channel measurements" (measured data, the case admitted by q5); no code or data link is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Eligible: the autoencoder and Conv-GRU are learned and the function is channel prediction and synthesis (area 2) across frequency bands; the Rx arrays have 16 to 32 antennas, so it is not a single-antenna link. The stated purpose is channel modeling, but the learned model predicts the angular PSD in unseen bands (pp. 1, 4). q5 rests on the clause on measured data: the measurements are the authors' own and are not released, so the reviewer should confirm. q3 is not met: the compared networks are learned and replace the Conv-GRU cell or remove the autoencoder of the same structure (p. 10). q4 rests on the parameter count only. PDF checked: page 1 holds the title and DOI 10.1109/TCOMM.2024.3376602.
